server.name: io.github.JohnBilousov/appstore-play-mcp
server.description: Read-only access to App Store Connect and Google Play: apps, releases, and reviews.
server.title: App Store & Google Play

environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect API key id. Omit the App Store block to run Play-only.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect issuer id.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Path to the AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8 private key downloaded from App Store Connect.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path to the Google service account JSON with Android Publisher access.
environmentVariables.name: PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Play package names. Required for Play: the API cannot list apps.
environmentVariables.name: PLAY_PACKAGES

server.name: io.github.JohnBilousov/vocabit-mcp
server.description: Create flashcard sets in the Vocabit app and read back how the learner actually did.
server.title: Vocabit

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Vocabit backend. Omit to run in demo mode with in-memory fixtures.
environmentVariables.name: VOCABIT_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Agent key sent as X-Agent-Key, issued by your Vocabit backend.
environmentVariables.name: VOCABIT_AGENT_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Firebase UID of the learner. Optional; the backend has a default.
environmentVariables.name: VOCABIT_USER_ID
